CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_owner(candidate uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.owner_accounts
    where user_id = candidate and active = true
  );
$function$
